title: DeepMimic: Example-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning of Physics-Based Character Skills
authors_or_org: Peng, Abbeel, Levine, van de Panne
claims: Combines motion-imitation and task rewards for physics-based skills; project links original code.
limitations: Simulated characters including an Atlas model are not real-robot deployment evidence.

title: AMP: Adversarial Motion Priors for Stylized Physics-Based Character Control
claims: Discriminator supplies a motion style reward without explicit clip selection.
limitations: Original evaluation concerns simulated characters.

title: ASE: Large-Scale Reusable Adversarial Skill Embeddings for Physically Simulated Characters
claims: Combines adversarial imitation and unsupervised RL into reusable latent skills.
limitations: Human-like simulated skills do not establish humanoid hardware safety.

title: Perpetual Humanoid Control for Real-time Simulated Avatars
claims: Progressive multiplicative control learns difficult motion and recovery without external stabilizing forces.
limitations: Original ICCV paper evaluates simulated avatars, not production humanoids.

title: PHC official implementation
claims: Official training and evaluation implementation and motion-data processing.
limitations: Repository evolution must not be backdated to original paper.

title: Learning Humanoid Locomotion with Transformers
authors_or_org: Radosavovic, Xiao, Zhang, Darrell, Malik, Sreenath
claims: Causal observation-action history transformer; randomized simulation RL; zero-shot real humanoid locomotion.
limitations: Locomotion and disturbance experiments, not a language-conditioned general manipulation model.

title: Learning Human-to-Humanoid Real-Time Whole-Body Teleoperation
authors_or_org: He, Luo, Xiao, Zhang, Kitani, Liu, Shi
claims: H2O uses retargeting and privileged imitation to filter motions, then sim-to-real tracking from RGB human poses.
limitations: Teleoperation transfers human decisions and should not be counted as autonomous task planning.

title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
authors_or_org: He, Luo, He, Xiao, Zhang, Zhang, Kitani, Liu, Shi
claims: Kinematic pose interface; privileged-teacher distillation; supports VR/video and learned autonomous goals; OmniH2O-6.
limitations: Six-task dataset and demonstrations are limited task coverage; separate autonomous and teleoperated trials.

title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
claims: 40 hours human-motion pretraining; RGB shadowing collects robot data for egocentric behavior cloning on a 33-DoF humanoid.
limitations: Task-specific demonstrations; reported task success is not an open-world metric.

title: MaskedMimic: Unified Physics-Based Character Control Through Masked Motion Inpainting
claims: Fully constrained tracking teacher and conditional-VAE partial-goal policy enable masked motion inpainting.
limitations: Physics-based animation is the primary evaluation domain; not an off-the-shelf sim-to-real humanoid policy.

title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
claims: Universal motion token, PPO motion tracking, target joint positions with PD control; GR00T N1.5 compatibility experiment.
limitations: Preprint v1 has inconsistent compute totals (abstract 9k vs results 32k GPU-hours); omit total compute. VLA experiment is 20 trials of one task.

title: GR00T-WholeBodyControl: SONIC and decoupled WBC
claims: 50-Hz SONIC; default, low-latency and v1.1 checkpoints; Apache-2.0 code and NVIDIA Open Model License weights; VLA workflows.
limitations: Dynamic main branch; lookahead horizon is not measured end-to-end latency; available data is not full original training corpus.

title: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
authors_or_org: Shah, Sridhar, Dashora, Stachowicz, Black, Hirose, Levine
claims: Goal-conditioned transformer pretrained across mobile-robot navigation datasets, adaptable goal tokens, long-range planner integration.
limitations: Kilometer-scale result includes planner/heuristics; do not credit a standalone motor policy.

title: General Navigation Models: GNM, ViNT and NoMaD
claims: Official model checkpoints, training, topological-map construction, navigation and exploration deployment.
limitations: Navigation output still requires embodiment-specific control; inherited software dependency versions may be old.

title: NoMaD: Goal Masking Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
claims: Explicitly uses ViNT encoder, goal masking and a diffusion action decoder to combine goal navigation with exploration.
limitations: Real mobile-robot experiments are not legged whole-body stability or manipulation tests.

title: GOAT: GO to Any Thing
claims: Modular navigation with persistent instance-aware semantic memory and multimodal goals; nine-home evaluation.
limitations: Mapping, perception and planning are part of the system; not one end-to-end transformer policy.

title: GOAT-Bench: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Lifelong Navigation
claims: Sequential multimodal navigation goals test reuse of environmental memory.
limitations: GOAT-Bench is a benchmark, distinct from GOAT the navigation system.

title: Helix: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Humanoid Control
claims: Original S2/S1 hierarchy for continuous upper-body humanoid control.
limitations: Vendor-reported demonstrations; no publicly audited broad success metric or complete reproduction package.

title: Introducing Helix 02: Full-Body Autonomy
claims: Adds S0 1-kHz whole-body controller to S1 200-Hz joint targets and S2 semantic latents; touch and palm vision; autonomous room-scale demo.
limitations: Author-selected four-minute demonstration, not independent reliability evidence; training mix and full architecture not disclosed.

title: The case for an omni-bodied robot brain
claims: Cross-embodiment training and adaptation; company reports randomized simulated bodies.
limitations: No public model weights or complete architecture in reviewed material; manufacturer account.

title: Introducing S1: In-Context Learning for Robotics
claims: Episodic demonstration-conditioned pretraining, video prompt for unseen manipulation; vendor distinguishes task and horizon generalization.
limitations: Exact model architecture, full data composition and reproducible held-out split undisclosed; detailed training deferred.

title: The Hidden Pillar of Robotics
authors_or_org: Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, Skild AI
claims: Company reports paying customers and distinguishes deploying, working-toward and piloting partner applications.
limitations: Revenue run rate and deployment claims are not independently audited here and do not isolate S1 performance.

title: π0.7: a Steerable Model with Emergent Capabilities
claims: Multimodal conditioning and specialist-experience distillation; demonstration of compositional generalization.
limitations: Some tasks use step-by-step coaching or a fine-tuned high-level policy; not all outcomes are zero-shot autonomy.

title: The Physical Intelligence Layer
authors_or_org: Physical Intelligence, Weave Robotics and Ultra
claims: Partner-authored customer-site accounts: laundry folding and warehouse packing; remote interventions explicitly retained.
limitations: Partner testimony rather than independent audit; autonomy-time percentage differs from per-task success.

title: GR00T N1.6: An Improved Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
claims: Cosmos-family VLM and enlarged 32-layer DiT; multiple manipulation embodiments.
limitations: A versioned historical model, not claimed to be the latest at cutoff.

title: NVIDIA Announces NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot for Academic Research
claims: Reference platform combines Unitree, Sharpa, Jetson Thor and GR00T; stated availability late 2026.
limitations: Announcement and planned shipment are not evidence of delivery by 2026-09-11.

title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
claims: Robotics 2, ER 2 and On-Device 2; whole-body multi-embodiment demonstrations and differentiated access routes.
limitations: Selected demonstrations and model cards; access to ER tools does not imply public access to all robot-control weights.

title: 1X World Model: From Video to Action, A New Way Robots Learn
claims: Video world model plus inverse dynamics; measured generation latency and limitations of current open-loop execution.
limitations: Five-second rollouts and slow server inference; long-horizon closed-loop memory identified as future work.

title: Order NEO
claims: Early owners receive basic autonomy; scheduled Expert Mode permits remote supervision; US deliveries stated to start 2026.
limitations: Order page is not delivered-fleet evidence; basic autonomy and expert help must be reported together.

title: GXO Signs Industry-First Multi-Year Agreement with Agility Robotics
claims: Customer confirms commercial RaaS agreement and Digit logistics deployment.
limitations: Customer confirmation supports deployment existence, not general-purpose model capability or independent safety certification.

title: Digit Moves Over 100,000 Totes in Commercial Deployment
claims: Vendor cumulative tote-movement milestone at GXO.
limitations: No public denominator for failed attempts, human assistance, downtime or total fleet hours.

title: Atlas Evolution From Research Robot to Industrial Humanoid
claims: Product Atlas manufactured; scheduled 2026 deployments; RL, teleoperation and full-body models in industrial part sequencing.
limitations: Scheduled deployment should not become proven fleet-scale autonomy; complete control-model recipe unpublished.

title: Galbot company and technology overview
claims: Galbot G1/S1 applications and AstraBrain WAM/WBC/DexNDM model positioning.
limitations: Marketing summary; global-first and shipment/scale claims are not accepted as comparative proof; detailed benchmarks not verified here.

title: UnifoLM-VLA official code and model release
claims: VLM/VLA checkpoints and G1/other robotic datasets offered through official repository.
limitations: Hardware availability and available model checkpoints do not prove general autonomous deployment.

title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
claims: Official listing places journal publication in Science Robotics in July 2026.
limitations: Different from initial November 2025 preprint date; technical discussion is pinned to the inspected preprint and current code.

title: HoloMotion: A Foundation Model for Whole-Body Humanoid Control
claims: Reference-conditioned mixture-of-experts transformer, motion-data and training/deployment pipeline.
limitations: Added as emerging direction; quantitative claims not independently reproduced or compared.

title: GEN-1: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Mastery
claims: Native physical-interaction pretraining; task adaptation; early-access partner program.
limitations: Reported 99% on selected tasks and speed comparisons do not apply to every physical task.

title: GEN-1.5: Embodied Foundation Models are One-Shot Learners
claims: 30-second context, sensorimotor prompting and 100-Hz trajectories; distinct zero-update and few-gradient-step adaptation.
limitations: Author calls tasks simple/short horizon and in-context behavior more brittle than finetuning; limited public reproducibility.

title: F.03 Arrives at BMW
claims: Figure 03 with Helix 02 demonstrates sequencing and cart movement at BMW Spartanburg.
limitations: Manufacturer demonstration at customer site; not a report of sustained fleet-wide autonomous reliability.

title: BMW Group advances the use of Physical AI in production with Figure 03 project in Spartanburg
claims: Customer confirms prior Figure 02 production pilot and new Figure 03 sequencing project.
limitations: Figure 02 metrics cannot be transferred to Figure 03/Helix 02; project announcement is narrower than full industrial rollout.
